issue.title: No result/logger information
issue.body:
The documentation for the logger and results is empty (https://el-openqaoa.readthedocs.io/en/latest/logger_and_results.html). I'm not sure if it doesn't exist or isn't being generated properly, but it is valuable documentation to have available.

issue.title: Fixing the docs
issue.body:
This PR:
- Fixes many bugs in the docs (especially in the utilities)
- Fixes the math display in the 4th notebook
- Adds the flag -W to the doc tests, which should fail if any warning is raised

This PR addresses
